script: Here is how to make cold brew coffee at home. First, grind your coffee beans coarsely, about as rough as sea salt. Put one cup of the ground coffee into a large glass jar. Pour in four cups of cold, filtered water and stir gently until all the grounds are wet. Close the lid and leave the jar in the fridge for twelve to eighteen hours. The next day, pour the coffee through a paper filter or a fine cloth into a clean bottle. What you have now is a strong concentrate. To serve, mix one part concentrate with one part water or milk, and add plenty of ice. Keep the bottle in the fridge and it stays fresh for about a week.
